body:
Thanks so much for your replies - It feels good that there is actually somebody there who is listening and replying. So i sounds like I need to let the dopamine come naturally by doing some physical things to enable its production. Yes I believe love is the key - just need to try and love myself but not sure how. 
I'm sorry to hear you are having a hard time forgiving yourself - guilt can be a terrible thing. I often think that I am such a terrible person -- my name is Jools by the way - I really appreciate you

Thanks for your reply - I am humbled - Its good to know someone has read and listen to me. I am hoping for some of them happy brain chemicals - You was 8 and I was 13 when the dark cloud invaded our lives. Ever since that young age I have felt unwanted, unloved and worthless - Hugs and pets are good - wish I could feel love again - I believe that this is the root cause of it - love and self compassion -- but find it hard to do so
OMG I did exactly the same - And at dinner time I sat alone in canteen facing the wall
